title: Background Radiation Monitor — J305

panels.title: Counts per Minute (CPM)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "cpm") |> last()

panels.description: Latest measured counts per minute.

panels.title: CPM — raw and 5-minute mean

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "cpm") |> set(key: "_field", value: "CPM raw")

from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "cpm") |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> set(key: "_field", value: "CPM 5 min mean")

panels.description: Raw CPM plus a 5-minute mean. The raw series preserves fast changes; the mean makes the background trend easier to read.

panels.title: Estimated dose rate (µSv/h)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "usvh") |> last()

panels.description: Estimated from CPM using the counter service USVH_RATIO. Use CPM as the primary measurement unless the detector has been calibrated against a reference instrument.

panels.title: Estimated dose rate — raw and 5-minute mean (µSv/h)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "usvh") |> set(key: "_field", value: "Estimated µSv/h raw")

from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "usvh") |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> set(key: "_field", value: "Estimated µSv/h 5 min mean")

panels.description: Stored estimated dose rate plus a 5-minute mean. The value is not a calibrated dose measurement unless the complete detector has been calibrated.

panels.title: Pulse rate (CPS)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "cps")

panels.description: Raw pulses detected in the most recent one-second window. A stable value near 50 CPS can indicate mains-frequency interference.

panels.title: Detector status

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "detector_status_code") |> last()

panels.description: Current detector state. WARMUP is expected during the first minute after startup; NO_PULSES can indicate a disconnected or bad signal contact.

panels.title: Last pulse age (s)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "last_pulse_age_s") |> last()

panels.description: Seconds since the most recent detected pulse. A steadily increasing value is useful for spotting a disconnected or bad contact.

panels.title: Calibration status

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "calibration_status_code") |> last()

panels.description: UNCALIBRATED by default. Change CALIBRATION_STATUS only after calibrating the complete detector against a suitable reference instrument.

panels.title: CPM → µSv/h factor

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "usvh_ratio") |> last()

panels.description: Current USVH_RATIO used for the estimated dose-rate field.

panels.title: Pulse total since start

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "pulse_total") |> last()

panels.description: Total pulses observed by the counter process since its last start.

panels.title: Counter uptime (s)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "uptime_s") |> last()

panels.description: Counter-process uptime in seconds. A reset to a small value indicates the counter service restarted.

panels.title: CPM statistical uncertainty (1σ)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "cpm_sigma") |> last()

panels.description: Approximate 1σ counting uncertainty for the current 60-second CPM window, using sqrt(N). This describes counting statistics only.

panels.title: Relative statistical uncertainty

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "cpm_relative_uncertainty_pct") |> last()

panels.description: Approximate relative 1σ uncertainty from Poisson counting statistics. It does not include tube response or calibration uncertainty.

panels.title: Estimated dose uncertainty (1σ, µSv/h)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "usvh_sigma") |> last()

panels.description: Counting-statistics contribution only. The uncertainty of the J305 conversion factor is additional and is not included until calibration.

panels.title: Current observed planetary Kp

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: -7d, stop: now()) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "space-weather-kp" and r._field == "kp" and r.feed == "observed") |> last()

panels.description: Latest observed 3-hour planetary Kp value from NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center. Kp 5 or greater indicates geomagnetic storm conditions on the NOAA scale.

panels.title: 3-day forecast peak Kp

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: -1h, stop: 4d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "space-weather-kp" and r._field == "kp" and r.feed == "forecast" and r.status == "predicted") |> max()

panels.description: Highest NOAA predicted planetary Kp value currently stored for the next three days.

options.content:
**NOAA planetary Kp scale**

Kp < 5: below geomagnetic storm level  
Kp 5: G1  •  Kp 6: G2  •  Kp 7: G3  •  Kp 8 / 9−: G4  •  Kp 9o: G5

Source: NOAA / NWS Space Weather Prediction Center. Data are fetched from the official observed and 3-day forecast JSON products.

panels.title: Planetary Kp — observed, estimated and 3-day forecast

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: -7d, stop: now()) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "space-weather-kp" and r._field == "kp" and r.feed == "observed") |> set(key: "_field", value: "Observed Kp")

from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: -1d, stop: 4d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "space-weather-kp" and r._field == "kp" and r.feed == "forecast" and r.status == "estimated") |> set(key: "_field", value: "Estimated Kp")

from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: -1d, stop: 4d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "space-weather-kp" and r._field == "kp" and r.feed == "forecast" and r.status == "predicted") |> set(key: "_field", value: "Predicted Kp")

panels.description: NOAA SWPC planetary Kp context. Observed values are measured/published 3-hour indices; estimated values cover the interval in progress; predicted values are the NOAA 3-day forecast. Kp 5 is the geomagnetic-storm threshold.

panels.title: NOAA 3-day Kp forecast data

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: -1h, stop: 4d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "space-weather-kp" and r._field == "kp" and r.feed == "forecast" and r.status == "predicted") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "status"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Kp", status: "Type"}) |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.description: Current NOAA SWPC predicted Kp values in 3-hour intervals. Forecasts can change when NOAA issues a new forecast.

panels.title: Surface pressure (hPa)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "local-weather" and r._field == "surface_pressure_hpa") |> last()

panels.description: Current surface pressure from Open-Meteo for the automatically detected or manually configured installation location.

panels.title: Rain (mm)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "local-weather" and r._field == "rain_mm") |> last()

panels.description: Current Open-Meteo rain amount for the installation location.

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "local-weather" and r._field == "temperature_c") |> last()
from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "local-weather" and r._field == "relative_humidity_pct") |> last()

panels.title: Solar-wind speed (km/s)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "space-weather-solar-wind" and r._field == "speed_km_s") |> last()

panels.description: Latest solar-wind speed from NOAA SWPC.

panels.title: IMF Bz GSM (nT)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "space-weather-solar-wind" and r._field == "bz_gsm_nt") |> last()

panels.description: Latest north/south IMF Bz component in GSM coordinates from NOAA SWPC.

panels.title: CPM — 15-minute mean correlation reference

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "cpm") |> aggregateWindow(every: 15m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> set(key: "_field", value: "CPM 15 min mean")

panels.description: Radiation reference series aligned with the environmental and space-weather panels below. Visual coincidence does not establish causation.

panels.title: Local weather — pressure

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "local-weather" and r._field == "surface_pressure_hpa") |> set(key: "_field", value: "Surface pressure hPa")

panels.description: Surface pressure aligned in time with CPM for visual comparison.

panels.title: Local weather — rain and precipitation

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "local-weather" and r._field == "rain_mm") |> set(key: "_field", value: "Rain mm")

from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "local-weather" and r._field == "precipitation_mm") |> set(key: "_field", value: "Precipitation mm")

panels.description: Open-Meteo precipitation context. Rainfall can be spatially localized; IP-based location is approximate.

panels.title: Local weather — temperature and humidity

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "local-weather" and r._field == "temperature_c") |> set(key: "_field", value: "Temperature °C")

from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "local-weather" and r._field == "relative_humidity_pct") |> set(key: "_field", value: "Relative humidity %")

panels.description: Temperature and relative humidity context for detector/environment interpretation.

panels.title: Solar wind — speed and IMF Bz

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "space-weather-solar-wind" and r._field == "speed_km_s") |> set(key: "_field", value: "Solar-wind speed km/s")

from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "space-weather-solar-wind" and r._field == "bz_gsm_nt") |> set(key: "_field", value: "IMF Bz GSM nT")

panels.description: NOAA SWPC solar-wind context. Bz and speed use different units; compare timing and sign rather than absolute magnitudes.

panels.title: Dst geomagnetic index (nT)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "space-weather-dst" and r._field == "dst_nt") |> set(key: "_field", value: "Dst nT")

panels.description: Kyoto Dst index as distributed by NOAA SWPC.

panels.title: GOES integral proton flux ≥10 MeV (pfu)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "space-weather-protons" and r._field == "flux_pfu" and r.energy == ">=10MeV") |> set(key: "_field", value: "≥10 MeV proton flux pfu")

panels.description: Latest GOES integral proton flux series from NOAA SWPC. A logarithmic display may be useful during large events.

panels.title: Weather location context

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: -7d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "local-weather" and (r._field == "latitude" or r._field == "longitude" or r._field == "city" or r._field == "region" or r._field == "country")) |> last() |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "location_source", "latitude", "longitude", "city", "region", "country"])

panels.description: Location used for Open-Meteo. location_source=ip means approximate public-IP geolocation; manual means WEATHER_LATITUDE/WEATHER_LONGITUDE were supplied.

description: J305 background-radiation monitor with signal diagnostics, Poisson counting uncertainty, NOAA SWPC planetary Kp/solar-wind/Dst/proton context, and automatically geolocated Open-Meteo weather context. CPM remains the primary radiation measurement.
